declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeFrontierTuples_ownedCell_cutoff_invariant
declarations.type:
∀ (k : ℕ) (parent : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (N cap : ℕ),
  1 < N →
    ∀ (a b : ℝ),
      a < b →
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (m + 1)) (z : ℝ),
          ↑N ^ b ≤ z →
            {p ∈ ImbalancedChen.firstExitFrontierTuples k parent (ImbalancedChen.roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z) |
                ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈ ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell a b m j} =
              {p ∈
                  ImbalancedChen.firstExitFrontierTuples k parent (ImbalancedChen.roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 (↑N ^ b)) |
                ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈ ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell a b m j}

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.historicalUpperFiveFrontierTuples_cell_filter
declarations.type:
∀ (D : ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData),
  D.a < D.b →
    0 < D.old →
      D.levelCheck = true →
        ∀ (N cap : ℕ),
          1 < N →
            ↑N ^ ↑D.b ≤ ↑cap →
              ∀ (j : Fin 5 → Fin (D.m + 1)),
                {p ∈
                      ImbalancedChen.firstExitFrontierTuples 4 (D.upperThirdPolicy ↑N)
                        (ImbalancedChen.roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 (↑N ^ ↑D.b)) |
                    ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈ ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell (↑D.a) (↑D.b) D.m j} =
                  {p ∈ ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeBoxTuples N (fun x => ↑D.a) fun x => ↑D.b |
                    ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈
                      ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell (↑D.a) (↑D.b) D.m j ∩
                        ImbalancedChen.primeAffineGateRegion ImbalancedChen.ordinaryUpperFiveGateForms
                          (D.fifthParentGateBounds j)}

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.historicalUpperFive_cube_tests_iff_log
declarations.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  1 < N →
    ∀ (old third : ℝ) (p : Fin 5 → ℕ),
      (∀ (i : Fin 5), 0 < p i) →
        (↑(p 0) ^ 3 < ↑N ^ old ∧ ↑(p 0) * ↑(p 1) * ↑(p 2) ^ 3 < ↑N ^ third ↔
          3 * ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p 0 < old ∧
            ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p 0 + ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p 1 +
                3 * ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p 2 <
              third)

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.mem_historicalUpperFiveFrontierTuples_iff_log_on_cell
declarations.type:
∀ (D : ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData),
  D.a ≤ D.b →
    0 < D.old →
      D.levelCheck = true →
        ∀ (N cap : ℕ),
          1 < N →
            ↑N ^ ↑D.b ≤ ↑cap →
              ∀ (p : Fin 5 → ℕ) (j : Fin 5 → Fin (D.m + 1)),
                ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈ ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell (↑D.a) (↑D.b) D.m j →
                  (p ∈
                      ImbalancedChen.firstExitFrontierTuples 4 (D.upperThirdPolicy ↑N)
                        (ImbalancedChen.roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 (↑N ^ ↑D.b)) ↔
                    StrictAnti p ∧
                      (∀ (i : Fin 5), Nat.Prime (p i) ∧ ¬p i ∣ N ∧ 0 ≤ ↑(p i) ∧ ↑(p i) < ↑N ^ ↑D.b) ∧
                        3 * ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p 0 < ↑D.old ∧
                          ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p 0 + ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p 1 +
                              3 * ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p 2 <
                            ↑(D.cell3 (ImbalancedChen.historicalPrefixProject ⋯ j)))

declarations.name: _private.ImbalancedChen.HistoricalUpperFiveCellGeometry.0.ImbalancedChen.historicalUpperFive_parent_valid_iff
declarations.type:
∀ (Q : ℝ),
  1 < Q →
    ∀ (Q3 : List ℕ → ℝ) (p : Fin 5 → ℕ),
      (∀ (i : Fin 5), Nat.Prime (p i)) →
        StrictAnti p →
          Q ≤ Q3 [p 2, p 1, p 0] →
            (ImbalancedChen.FirstExitValidSelection
                (ImbalancedChen.thirdCappedUpperPolicy (ImbalancedChen.ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false Q) Q3) [] true
                (List.ofFn p).dropLast ↔
              ↑(p 0) ^ 3 < Q ∧ ↑(p 0) * ↑(p 1) * ↑(p 2) ^ 3 < Q3 [p 2, p 1, p 0])

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData.actualHistoricalFifthSaving_eq_fifthPrimeCorrection
declarations.type:
∀ (D : ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData) (N cap : ℕ),
  ImbalancedChen.actualHistoricalFifthSaving (ImbalancedChen.ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false (↑N ^ ↑D.old))
          (D.level3 ↑N) (D.level4 ↑N) (D.level5 ↑N) N cap (↑N ^ ↑D.b) *
        Real.log ↑N /
      ImbalancedChen.singularSeries N =
    D.fifthPrimeCorrection N cap

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData.actualHistoricalFifthSaving_eq_fifthPrimeCorrection_of_cutoff_ge
declarations.type:
∀ (D : ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData),
  D.a < D.b →
    ∀ (N cap : ℕ),
      1 < N →
        ∀ (z : ℝ),
          ↑N ^ ↑D.b ≤ z →
            ImbalancedChen.actualHistoricalFifthSaving (ImbalancedChen.ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false (↑N ^ ↑D.old))
                    (D.level3 ↑N) (D.level4 ↑N) (D.level5 ↑N) N cap z *
                  Real.log ↑N /
                ImbalancedChen.singularSeries N =
              D.fifthPrimeCorrection N cap

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData.actualHistoricalFifthSaving_eq_tupleSum_at_cutoff
declarations.type:
∀ (D : ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData) (N cap : ℕ) (z : ℝ),
  ImbalancedChen.actualHistoricalFifthSaving (ImbalancedChen.ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false (↑N ^ ↑D.old))
          (D.level3 ↑N) (D.level4 ↑N) (D.level5 ↑N) N cap z *
        Real.log ↑N /
      ImbalancedChen.singularSeries N =
    ∑
      p ∈
        ImbalancedChen.firstExitFrontierTuples 4 (D.upperThirdPolicy ↑N) (ImbalancedChen.roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z),
      (∏ i, 1 / (↑(p i) - 1)) * D.fifthTupleOwnCubeDifference N cap p

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData.fifthCellIntegral_eq_integral
declarations.type:
∀ (D : ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData),
  0 < D.a →
    D.a < D.b →
      ∀ (j : Fin 5 → Fin (D.m + 1)),
        D.fifthCellIntegral j =
          ∫ (t : Fin 5 → ℝ) in
            ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell (↑D.a) (↑D.b) D.m j ∩
              ImbalancedChen.primeAffineGateRegion ImbalancedChen.ordinaryUpperFiveGateForms
                (D.fifthParentGateBounds j),
            (ImbalancedChen.primeOwnCubeGatedProfile (↑(D.cap5 j)) t -
                ImbalancedChen.primeOwnCubeGatedProfile (↑(D.old5 j)) t) *
              ∏ i, 1 / t i

declarations.type: (D : ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData) → ℕ → ℕ → (Fin 5 → Fin (D.m + 1)) → ℝ

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData.fifthCellPrimeCorrection_eq_residual_sums
declarations.type:
∀ (D : ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData),
  D.a < D.b →
    0 < D.old →
      D.levelCheck = true →
        ∀ (N cap : ℕ),
          1 < N →
            ↑N ^ ↑D.b ≤ ↑cap →
              ∀ j ∈ D.cells5,
                D.fifthCellPrimeCorrection N cap j =
                  ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeBoxOwnCubeMinusSum 4 N cap (↑D.a) (↑D.b) (↑(D.cap5 j))
                      (ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell (↑D.a) (↑D.b) D.m j ∩
                        ImbalancedChen.primeAffineGateRegion ImbalancedChen.ordinaryUpperFiveGateForms
                          (D.fifthParentGateBounds j)) -
                    ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeBoxOwnCubeMinusSum 4 N cap (↑D.a) (↑D.b) (↑(D.old5 j))
                      (ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell (↑D.a) (↑D.b) D.m j ∩
                        ImbalancedChen.primeAffineGateRegion ImbalancedChen.ordinaryUpperFiveGateForms
                          (D.fifthParentGateBounds j))

          ∫ (t : Fin 5 → ℝ) in
            ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell (↑D.a) (↑D.b) D.m j ∩
              ImbalancedChen.primeAffineGateRegion ImbalancedChen.ordinaryUpperFiveGateForms
                (D.fifthParentGateBounds j),
            (ImbalancedChen.primeOwnCubeGatedProfile (↑(D.cap5 j)) t -

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData.fifthFrontier_cell_weighted_sum
declarations.type:
∀ (D : ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData),
  D.a < D.b →
    0 < D.old →
      D.levelCheck = true →
        ∀ (N cap : ℕ),
          1 < N →
            ↑N ^ ↑D.b ≤ ↑cap →
              ∀ (j : Fin 5 → Fin (D.m + 1)) (f : (Fin 5 → ℕ) → ℝ),
                (∑
                    p ∈
                      ImbalancedChen.firstExitFrontierTuples 4 (D.upperThirdPolicy ↑N)
                        (ImbalancedChen.roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 (↑N ^ ↑D.b)),
                    (∏ i, 1 / (↑(p i) - 1)) *
                      if
                          ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈
                            ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell (↑D.a) (↑D.b) D.m j then
                        f p
                      else 0) =
                  ∑ p ∈ ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeBoxTuples N (fun x => ↑D.a) fun x => ↑D.b,
                    (∏ i, 1 / (↑(p i) - 1)) *
                      if
                          ImbalancedChen.actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈
                            ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell (↑D.a) (↑D.b) D.m j ∩
                              ImbalancedChen.primeAffineGateRegion ImbalancedChen.ordinaryUpperFiveGateForms
                                (D.fifthParentGateBounds j) then
                        f p
                      else 0

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData.fifthOwnCubeDifference_normalized_outside
declarations.type:
∀ (D : ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData) (N cap : ℕ) {history : List ℕ},
  history.length = 5 →
    (∀ j ∈ D.cells5,
        ImbalancedChen.primeHistoryLogCoordinates (↑N) 5 history ∉
          ImbalancedChen.logPrimeMeshCell (↑D.a) (↑D.b) D.m j) →
      (ImbalancedChen.actualOwnCubeGatedMinusDensity N cap (D.level5 ↑N) history -
              ImbalancedChen.actualOwnCubeGatedMinusDensity N cap
                (fun pre => D.level4 (↑N) (ImbalancedChen.rosserAncestor 4 pre)) history) *
            Real.log ↑N /
          ImbalancedChen.singularSeries N =
        0

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData.fifthTupleOwnCubeDifference_on_cell

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData.fifthTupleSum_cutoff_invariant

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.HistoricalPrefixCapData.level4_ancestor_ownCube_normalized_history
